stem: Let f be a function such that 3f(x) + 2f(m/(19x)) = 5x, x ≠ 0, where m = Σ (from i=1 to 9) i². Then f(5) − f(2) is equal to [JEE Main 2026, 24 Jan Shift-1] (a) −9 (b) 9 (c) 18 (d) 36

Consider the function f : R → R defined by f(x) = 2x/√(1 + 9x²). If the composition of f, (f∘f∘f∘…∘f)(x) [f taken 10 times] = 2^(10) x/√(1 + 9αx²), then the value of √(3α + 1) is equal to ______ [JEE Main 2024 (4 Apr Shift-2)]

The equation x² − 4x + [x] + 3 = x[x], where [x] denotes the greatest integer function, has: [JEE Main 2023, 24 Jan Shift-1] (a) exactly two solutions in (−∞, ∞) (b) no solution (c) a unique solution in (−∞, 1) (d) a unique solution in (−∞, ∞)

The domain of the function f(x) = sin⁻¹[2x² − 3] + log₂(log_(1/4)(x² − 5x + 5)), where [t] is the greatest integer function, is: [JEE Main 2022, 27 Jul Shift-2] (a) (−√(5/2), (5 − √5)/2) (b) ((5 − √5)/2, (5 + √5)/2) (c) (1, (5 − √5)/2) (d) [1, (5 + √3)/2)
